snippet.title: Fear Tall Grass | Announcement
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4418130/Fear_Tall_Grass/

Fear Tall Grass is a dark fantasy autobattler roguelike creature collector set in a world consumed by Vilekin, evil creatures that are destroying civilization. As Gray, the last steward of the Oathguard, you must brave the tall grass to learn to tame these creatures and protect what remains of humanity. 

Official Webpage: https://entaltostudios.com/fear-tall-grass
